name: public-page
js: const a = [...document.querySelectorAll('header a')].find((e) => e.textContent.trim() === 'How to apply'); a.style.outline = '5px solid #B4502A'; a.style.outlineOffset = '4px';

name: page-new-photo
js: const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((e) => e.textContent.includes('Choose photo')); b.style.outline = '5px solid #B4502A'; b.style.outlineOffset = '4px';

name: page-edit
js: const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((e) => e.textContent.includes('Remove photo')); b.style.outline = '5px solid #B4502A'; b.style.outlineOffset = '4px';

name: board-order
js: const row = [...document.querySelectorAll('li, article, .director-card, div')].filter((e) => e.textContent.includes('Margit Halvorsen') && e.querySelector('button')).pop(); for (const b of row.querySelectorAll('button')) { if (/Move (up|down)/.test(b.textContent)) { b.style.outline = '5px solid #B4502A'; b.style.outlineOffset = '3px'; } }
